flags.reasoning: Kit says 'of the skill user's Max HP' (caster-scaled) but targetMaxHpPct scales by target's own Max HP. Mismatch is harmless because ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct (e3 rule) — the grant is offensively inert. Would matter only if a future consumer/scaler reads a caster-scaled Max-HP grant.
